data.title: 三司绫濑 · 把书留到明天
data.description: 绫濑在沙发上读书，你坐到她身边时，她把书签夹回那一页。她轻轻靠过来，说剩下的明天再看，今晚想和你待一会儿。
data.action: closing a book and leaning toward her partner
data.promptProse: Cozy on the plush living room sofa, Ayase gently closes her hardcover book, marking the page with a delicate bookmark. She leans softly toward her partner, her posture relaxed and content, while the golden, warm light from a nearby floor lamp casts a gentle glow over the open book, soft cushion textures, and the tranquil evening atmosphere of their home.
data.animaCaption: Her partner is beside her but remains outside the frame.
